improvements.reason: Readiness now observes the configured source and reports its actual account availability instead of reproducing skipped/scan-counter placeholders. This is not a changed certified figure; the board applies no waiver.

A genuine authentication dependency failure maps to JSON 503 without a bearer challenge, rather than misclassifying an unavailable dependency as invalid credentials. The rule applies at the shared protected-route boundary.

Invalid consumer settings and attempted changes to startup-only controls are refused with JSON 422 and the prior host-local overlay is restored, rather than acknowledging ignored or partially applied configuration.
